mapper.select: SELECT aging_type, COUNT(1) AS project_cnt, SUM(balance) AS total_balance, SUM(not_due1_to30_days) AS not_due1, SUM(not_due31_to90_days) AS not_due31, SUM(not_due91_to180_days) AS not_due91, SUM(not_due181_days) AS not_due181, SUM(due1_to30_days) AS due1, SUM(due31_to90_days) AS due31, SUM(due91_to180_days) AS due91, SUM(due181_to360_days) AS due181, SUM(due361_to720_days) AS due361, SUM(due721_to1080_days) AS due721, SUM(due1081_to1440_days) AS due1081, SUM(due1441_days) AS due1441 FROM t_age_analysis WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND kjyear_month = #{kjyearMonth} GROUP BY aging_type ORDER BY aging_type

SELECT report_type, COUNT(1) AS batch_cnt, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows, SUM(success_rows) AS success_rows, SUM(fail_rows) AS fail_rows, MAX(start_time) AS last_time FROM t_import_log GROUP BY report_type ORDER BY report_type
